episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Georgia Miller arrives in the quaint New England town of Wellsbury with her daughter, Ginny, and her son, Austin, and quickly makes a big impression.

episodes.title: It's a Face Not a Mask
episodes.summary: As Ginny struggles to fit in with her new friends, she faces fallout from a night with Marcus. Georgia helps problem-solve for both Paul and Ellen.

episodes.title: Next Level Rich People Shit
episodes.summary: During the Sophomore Sleepover, Max bares her heart, Georgia resorts to old, bad habits, and Ginny shares connections with both Hunter and Marcus.

episodes.title: Lydia Bennett Is Hundo a Feminist
episodes.summary: Hunter's aloofness makes Ginny insecure. Max obsesses over a new love interest. Georgia sells Paul on an idea for a fundraiser — then has to deliver.

episodes.title: Boo, Bitch
episodes.summary: As Ginny's popularity grows, so do her questions about her own identity. After his night out with Georgia, Paul finds he has new political competition.

episodes.title: I'm Triggered
episodes.summary: Unplanned visitors cause headaches for Georgia and trust issues for Ginny, as more of Georgia's checkered past is brought to light.

episodes.title: Happy Sweet Sixteen, Jerk
episodes.summary: On Ginny's 16th birthday, Georgia tries to smooth things over by organizing a surprise party for her — but Ginny and her friends have other big plans.

episodes.title: Check One, Check Other
episodes.summary: Ginny draws inspiration from her dad when writing an essay she hopes to submit to a prestigious contest — but the result breeds friction with Hunter.

episodes.title: Feelings Are Hard
episodes.summary: While Ginny and Georgia both find themselves caught between two men, Max and Marcus face painful situations of different sorts.

episodes.title: The Worst Betrayal Since Jordyn and Kylie
episodes.summary: As election day approaches for Paul, secrets start to catch up with Ginny and Georgia — and the fallout for both could be steep.

episodes.title: Welcome Back, Bitches!
episodes.summary: The kids spend Thanksgiving with Zion, who helps Ginny through an emotional ordeal. Georgia has an awkward dinner with Paul's parents.

episodes.title: Why Does Everything Have to Be So Terrible, All the Time, Forever?
episodes.summary: Georgia worries Nick will reveal what he knows as she schemes her way up the Wellsbury social ladder. At school, Ginny gets an icy reception.

episodes.title: What Are You Playing at, Little Girl?
episodes.summary: After plotting revenge on a school mom, Georgia opens up about her troubled past to Ginny. Paul moves in with the Millers.

episodes.title: Happy My Birthday to You
episodes.summary: Paul and Georgia clash over her parenting style, Ginny throws a rager, and Cynthia finds love in an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Latkes Are Lit
episodes.summary: After a night out with Zion, Paul comes home to a startling discovery. Austin receives a surprise visitor at school.

episodes.title: A Very Merry Ginny & Georgia Christmas Special
episodes.summary: Sparks fly as Paul and Zion's families join the Millers for a holiday dinner. Austin looks for his Christmas gifts — and makes a dangerous find.

episodes.title: Let Us Serenade the Sh*t Out of You
episodes.summary: Georgia insists on going to Ginny's therapy session, where raw truths emerge. Gil pushes his way into Austin's life and Georgia finds cause to celebrate.

episodes.title: Hark! Darkness Descends!
episodes.summary: After a sudden behavior change raises concern among his friends, Marcus has a tearful meeting with Ginny. Austin witnesses a terrifying scene.

episodes.title: Kill Gil
episodes.summary: A buried secret comes to light. Joe and Georgia reminisce. An already heartbroken Ginny overhears upsetting news.

episodes.title: I'm No Cinderella
episodes.summary: As Gil continues to make threats and Cordova closes in, revelations about Georgia's past surface at the worst possible time.

episodes.title: This Wouldn’t Even Be a Podcast
episodes.summary: With all of Wellsbury abuzz about her arrest, Georgia's history of lies threatens to unravel. Facing personal struggles, Ginny and Marcus reconnect.

episodes.title: Beep Beep Freaking Beep
episodes.summary: Georgia and her attorney spar over defense strategy. As Ginny finds a creative way to channel her feelings, Zion weighs what's best for his daughter.

episodes.title: Friends Can Dance
episodes.summary: Old sparks — and heartaches — reignite at the school's spring dance. Austin faces rejection in the classroom, while Paul weathers turmoil at the office.

episodes.title: The Bitch Is Back
episodes.summary: As jury selection begins, Georgia puts her keen observational skills to good use. An impulsive decision jeopardizes Marcus' future.

episodes.title: Boom Goes The Dynamite
episodes.summary: An explosive testimony transforms the trial. To distract herself from her home life, Ginny connects with an intriguing outsider.

episodes.title: At Least It Can’t Get Any Worse
episodes.summary: Cut off from support, Georgia hits an emotional rock bottom. Paul's political challenges mount. To ease the tension, Max summons her BFFs.

episodes.title: That’s Wild
episodes.summary: Desperate to speak with her mom, Ginny relies on Max and Sophie to clear the way. Gil tries to win Austin's trust.

episodes.title: Is That A Packed Lunch
episodes.summary: As the prosecution rests, a dramatic shift in the case raises the stakes for Georgia. Ginny opens up to her dad and opens doors with her writing.

episodes.title: It’s Time For My Solo
episodes.summary: Georgia welcomes an unlikely advocate in the courtroom. As the curtain rises on the school musical, emotions run high and painful secrets emerge.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: With Georgia's freedom on the line, the trial reaches a dramatic conclusion. Ginny takes a page from her mom's playbook.
